written.headline: Mistral releases weights for 1-trillion-parameter model Le Chonk
written.summary: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model trained on European infrastructure. The model achieves 41% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 79% on CyberGym-E2E.
